purpose: A vertical list of items with a title, description, leading icon and trailing detail. It becomes a keyboard list when items can be chosen or opened.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ id: string; title: string; description?: string; meta?: string; icon?: IconName }>

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Makes items selectable. Defaults to none

props.name: onAction
props.description: Makes items openable; called with the id

whenToUse: For a set of similar items such as recent projects or notifications
antiPatterns: Lists with very different item shapes
Several actions per row without a menu

anatomy: Rows with an optional leading icon, title and description, and trailing meta; 1px dividers
sizes: Rows at least `size-control-lg` tall; padding `space-component-padding-sm` by `space-component-padding-md`
states: Interactive rows: hover `color-state-layer`, selected `color-container-primary`, focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`

a11yNotes: Static lists are list and listitem
Interactive lists are a grid list: arrows move, Space selects, Enter opens
